node.label: Lisch epithelial corneal dystrophy
node.definition: Lisch epithelial corneal dystrophy (LECD) is a very rare form of superficial corneal dystrophy characterized by feather-shaped opacities and microcysts in the corneal epithelium arranged in a band-shaped and sometimes whorled pattern, occasionally with impaired vision.
synonyms: band-shaped and whorled microcystic dystrophy of the corneal epithelium
corneal dystrophy, Lisch epithelial, X-linked dominant
